records.title: Mission Mausam
details: (a) It was inter-alia stated that the Mission Mausam is launched to make Bharat a "weather-ready and climate-smart" nation, with the following objectives:- To achieve the above, Mission Mausam intends to augment the Doppler Weather Radars (DWRs) network across the country for complete radar coverage along with other surface and upper air observing networks and enhance the accuracy of weather monitoring. (b) Key infrastructure like DWRs, radiometers, radiosondes, and wind profilers across the country are planned to be installed by 2026.
